pr_body:
The failure was caused by selected shards that were not in started state (they remained initializing/rebalancing). The fix adds a check to ensure shards are not only assigned byt also started.

Closes: #93817

Following code moves STARTED `warmShards` to the warm nodes (as it is impossible to move INITIALIZING shards), however some of the `warmShards` remained initializing after this loop due to ongoing rebalancing.

For the seed suggested in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/93817 we pick `{[test-7][0], [test-7][1], [test-7][3]}`, however `[test-7][3]` is not initialized.
